name: Login Mobile

endpoints.description: Autentikasi Operator/Supervisor via mobile, mengembalikan Sanctum personal access token untuk disimpan lokal (mendukung sesi offline berikutnya)

error_codes.condition: business area tidak sesuai penugasan user
password tidak memenuhi format minimal 6 karakter alfanumerik+simbol, atau field wajib kosong

business_logic: 1. Validate request body → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Validate format password → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. Lookup user by username → if not found/password mismatch: return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
4. Check user.is_active → if false: return 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE
5. Check business_unit_id cocok dengan penugasan user → if mismatch: return 403 BUSINESS_AREA_MISMATCH
6. Buat Sanctum personal access token (nama = device_name)

data_operations.description: SELECT user by username WHERE username = input

edge_case_handling.condition: Tidak ada koneksi saat login pertama kali (device belum pernah aktivasi)
edge_case_handling.handling: Client-side check: jika device belum pernah punya token tersimpan dan tidak ada koneksi, blokir submit dan tampilkan pesan 'koneksi internet diperlukan untuk login pertama kali' — tidak memanggil API

edge_case_handling.condition: Token sesi lokal kadaluarsa saat offline dalam waktu lama
edge_case_handling.handling: Client-side: deteksi token lokal invalid/expired, arahkan user ke layar login dan minta re-login online

business_rules_applied: Password minimal 6 karakter, case-sensitive, kombinasi alfanumerik+simbol
Login pertama kali memerlukan koneksi internet aktif

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when request body is invalid (missing/empty required fields)
unit_test_cases.given: request body missing or empty required field(s) e.g. username, password, business_unit_id, or device_name
unit_test_cases.expect: return 422 with error_code VALIDATION_ERROR, no user lookup performed

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when password format is invalid
unit_test_cases.given: password provided but length < 6 characters or does not match required alphanumeric+symbol format
unit_test_cases.expect: return 422 with error_code VALIDATION_ERROR before credential lookup

unit_test_cases.description: returns 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS when user not found or password mismatch
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo.findByUsername() returns null, OR returns a user but password hash check fails

unit_test_cases.description: returns 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE when user.is_active is false
unit_test_cases.given: userRepo.findByUsername() returns a user with is_active = false and matching password

unit_test_cases.description: returns 403 BUSINESS_AREA_MISMATCH when business_unit_id does not match user's assignment
unit_test_cases.given: user is active, password matches, but request.business_unit_id is not among user's assigned business units

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: request body valid, password format valid, userRepo.findByUsername() returns an active user with matching password and matching business_unit_id
unit_test_cases.expect: create Sanctum personal access token named device_name; return 200 with { user, business_unit, token }

implementation_notes: Token Sanctum disimpan lokal di device (secure storage) untuk mendukung sesi offline berikutnya, sesuai shared-decisions.auth.session_strategy
Verifikasi token lokal saat offline sepenuhnya di sisi client, tidak ada panggilan API — durasi validitas token offline belum ditentukan (open question di business spec)
Deteksi 'tidak ada koneksi saat login pertama kali' dilakukan client-side (device belum pernah punya token tersimpan) — submit diblokir sebelum memanggil API
Lupa Password membutuhkan koneksi internet, di luar scope tech spec ini (belum ada usecase terpisah)

component_test.action: fill valid username/NIK and password, select matching Business Area, click Login button
component_test.assert: loading state shown during submit; on success navigates to Home; session token persisted to local storage for offline use

browser_test.action: open mobile login screen, enter valid username and password, select Business Area, tap Login
browser_test.assert: user is redirected to Home screen; session stored locally for subsequent offline use

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Mobile — Tidak Ada Koneksi Saat Login Pertama

component_test.action: simulate a device with no previously stored token (first-time activation) and no internet connectivity, then click Login button
component_test.assert: submit is blocked client-side (no API call made); error message 'koneksi internet diperlukan untuk login pertama kali' is displayed

browser_test.action: on a fresh device with no network connection, attempt to submit the login form
browser_test.assert: login is blocked before any network request is sent; message about needing internet connection for first login is shown

component_test.action: fill username and/or password with incorrect values, click Login button
component_test.assert: error message displayed; password field is cleared; user can retry login

browser_test.action: enter wrong username or password, tap Login
browser_test.assert: error message shown; password field cleared; login form remains editable for retry

component_test.action: fill credentials belonging to a deactivated account, click Login button
component_test.assert: error message indicating account is inactive is shown; login rejected

browser_test.action: attempt login using a deactivated account's credentials
browser_test.assert: message displayed stating the account is inactive; user is not navigated to Home

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Mobile — Token Sesi Lokal Kadaluarsa

component_test.action: simulate an offline login attempt where the locally stored session token is expired
component_test.assert: user is redirected/prompted to the login screen requesting online re-authentication; no stale session is used

browser_test.action: attempt offline login with an expired locally-stored session token
browser_test.assert: app prompts user to re-login online and blocks access with the expired token

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Mobile — Password Tidak Memenuhi Format Minimum

component_test.action: fill a password shorter than 6 characters or not matching the required alphanumeric+symbol format, click Login button
component_test.assert: validation error message shown stating password format requirement not met; login rejected

browser_test.action: enter a password that does not meet the minimum format requirement, tap Login
browser_test.assert: error message shown indicating the password format requirement is not met

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Login Mobile — Business Area Tidak Sesuai Penugasan

component_test.action: select a Business Area not matching the user's assignment, fill valid credentials, click Login button
component_test.assert: error message shown that the selected Business Area does not match the user's assignment; login rejected

browser_test.action: select a mismatched Business Area/Company and submit otherwise valid credentials
browser_test.assert: login rejected with a message about the Business Area mismatch; user remains on login screen
